page.overview:
Who is Oscha?

Oscha, spelled Oscar in some official materials , is one of the main antagonists of Final Fantasy: Unlimited who also appears in unFinal Fantasy Unlimited: After. One of Earl Tyrant's four Lords of Gaudium, Oscha acts as his personal adviser and overseer of Chaos's growth. The unusual spelling of his name is due to it being an anagram of "Chaos".

Oscha is cruel and cold, not hesitating to manipulate others to reach his ends. He rarely appears to the protagonists, usually implementing his plans via his foes and friends alike. He exerts a degree of mental control over others, as seen in Oscha: The Endless Project, when he manipulates the workers into forfeiting their purpose in life to construct a giant robot.

Oscha can bend at angles impossible for humans, hang from ceilings, sprout and contract arms, and bullets rebound from his mask and skin as if they were coated in a strong metal. He emerges from surfaces via a shadow-like portal.

Oscha knows of Ai and Yu's true nature, creating Crux and altering the clock on Chobi's neck to pinpoint the twins' exact locations while having them experience various horrors and tragic events to mature them so they can be fused with the Earl, allowing Chaos to reach its zenith and evolve.
